thread:
Sam: Quick sync — planning to roll SDK v6 tonight 23:00 PT. Who's available to own the deploy and smoke watch?
Mira: I can own the deploy. I'll be online from 22:30 PT for prep.
Deepak: I'll do smoke tests and logs. Will run the regression prompt set and embedding checks.
Jordan: I'll handle client comms — changelog + migration note ready. Sending draft in a sec. :memo:
Sam: Awesome. High-level plan: canary 10% for 30m, then 50% 15m, full if green. Rollback window 45m post-full.
Mira: Deploy steps I plan to run:
```
# canary
./deploy sdk --version v6.0.0 --canary 10 --timeout 1800
# promote
./deploy sdk --promote --to 50 --timeout 900
# finalize
./deploy sdk --promote --to 100
```
Deepak: Smoke checklist (I will paste results as short lines):
- build sanity: artifacts passed checksum :white_check_mark:
- unit tests: 2 failing unrelated flaky tests (tracking ticket ENG-421) :warning:
- e2e quick: gen/chat, embeddings, rerank smoke ✅
- latency sanity on canary nodes: p95 under SLO at baseline +10%
Jordan: Client comms plan: publish changelog + migration guide, add note about removed param `use_legacy_token` and automatic fallback for older clients. Draft link: https://go.internal/docs/sdk-v6-migration
Sam: Backout commands if promo fails: `./deploy rollback --to v5.3.1` and trigger fallback routing to hosted v5 cluster via ops flag.
Mira: I'll tag deploy-bot and post canary start in #deployments when I kick off. Can someone monitor errors channel and trace sampling?
Deepak: I'll watch errors/traces and run the smoke automation script every 5m. My script: `scripts/smoke/run_all.sh --repeat 5 --report minimal`
Jordan: Also reminding product: we need a short note for customers about client compatibility and a compatibility matrix. I'll cc @product later.
Sam: Risks: minor API rename in responses (field `metadata` -> `meta`). We agreed on server-side shim for one release. Confirmed by Mira?
Mira: Yep, shim in runtime for v6 -> v5 mapping will be active during rollout. Verified on staging.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: job_id=canary-1796002468-1, targets=instances-group-sdks-canary
Deepak: If we see >3% 5xx or perf regression >20% p95, we abort and rollback.
Mira: Got it. I'll start at 22:50 PT to warm caches and run `./deploy sdk --dry-run` first.
Sam: Thanks — ping here when you start and when canary is promoted. I'll be reachable on phone if needed. :phone:
Jordan: I'll publish the public changelog at +30m after full if everything looks good.
Mira: Starting dry-run now.
Deepak: Monitoring ready.
Jordan: Draft changelog posted: https://go.internal/drafts/sdk-v6-changelog :eyes:
Sam: Great team — steady comms. We'll keep this thread as the single source for roll status updates. :thumbsup:
